name: CoherentRaster Rasterization Pipeline
definition: A rasterization pipeline for efficient 3D Gaussian Splatting on light field displays that synthesizes an interlaced light field image by separating view-dependent attributes from cluster-shared ones, using cross-view coherent attribute reuse and view-coherent remapping.
summary: CoherentRaster is a GPU-parallel rasterization pipeline for efficient 3D Gaussian Splatting on light field displays that uses cross-view attribute reuse and view-coherent remapping to eliminate redundant computations and enable coalesced memory accesses.
